aggregation.worst_outer_held_position_macro_f1: minimum of the two allowed-position means; each position mean equally averages the five canonical seeds
aggregation.mean_outer_held_position_macro_f1: arithmetic mean over the ten allowed position-by-seed units
aggregation.worst_class_recall: minimum across seven classes of class recall averaged over the ten allowed units; compact evidence does not expose per-class vectors, so this component may be reached only if the preceding components do not resolve the ordering
aggregation.zero_recall_class_frequency: zero-recall class occurrences divided by ten units times seven classes
aggregation.condition_block_macro_f1: arithmetic mean over the ten allowed units
aggregation.unique_signal_weighted_macro_f1: arithmetic mean over the ten allowed units
aggregation.across_seed_standard_deviation: population standard deviation of five seed means; each seed mean equally averages the two allowed positions

classification_rule: FAIL_PROTOCOL_OR_P4_SEAL_DEFECT if a protocol or P4-seal test fails
BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE_SELECTION_EVIDENCE if the exact 60-row source evidence grid is incomplete, duplicated, or has missing required metrics
SOURCE_SELECTION_VALIDITY_SUPPORTED if all three event-level primary regrets are zero within 1e-12
SOURCE_SELECTION_VALIDITY_PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED if one or two events recover held top-1 and the median event Spearman correlation is positive
SOURCE_SELECTION_RULE_NOT_PREDICTIVE if no event recovers held top-1 and the median event Spearman correlation is non-positive
